source_citation.quote: Chia seeds are the edible seeds of Salvia hispanica, a flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to central and southern Mexico.

notes: Botanically-unrelated namesake: chia (Lamiaceae, the mint family) is unrelated to sesame (Pedaliaceae) despite both being small edible seeds.
